text_blocks.snippet: Jardiance (empagliflozin) commonly causes increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: increased urination, urinary tract infections (UTIs), and genital yeast infections

list.snippet: Urinating more often: Extra sugar leaves your body through your urine, which pulls more water with it. Taking your dose in the morning can help prevent overnight bathroom trips.
UTIs: Higher sugar levels in urine allow bacteria to grow more easily, causing burning, pain, or urgency when you pee.
Genital yeast infections: These affect both women (vaginal yeast infections) and men (skin infections around the penis), causing itching, redness, or discharge.
Increased thirst and mild dehydration: Fluid loss can lead to dry mouth or mild dizziness when standing up.
Other mild effects: Upper respiratory tract infections (like a common cold), joint pain, or mild nausea.
Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA): A dangerous buildup of acid in the blood—even with normal blood sugar levels—marked by nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, trouble breathing, and fruity-smelling breath.
Dehydration and kidney injury: Severe fluid loss that can cause dizziness, fainting, or sudden worsening of kidney function.
Fournier’s Gangrene: A rare but severe and life-threatening genital or perineal bacterial infection causing intense pain, swelling, redness, and fever.
Severe allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or trouble breathing.
Low blood sugar (Hypoglycemia): More likely if combined with insulin or sulfonylureas.

text_blocks.snippet: You can review full safety guidelines and prescribing details directly on the Jardiance Official Site. You can also read more about managing reactions through GoodRx on Jardiance Side Effects.
